name: Nax Completion
description: Points an arrow at the nearest map completion point or jumping puzzle you have not done yet, keeps a per-character checklist, recognises points the game map already shows as done, and guides you through jumping puzzles along routes you record.

account.details: Needed with progression to tick jumping puzzles from your account's achievements.

characters.details: Needed with progression to tick hero challenges from the API, if ArenaNet fixes that endpoint.

progression.details: Needed for jumping puzzle achievements and hero challenges from the API.
